container.unordered_set.int_insert.description_en: Average cost of one std::unordered_set<int>::insert with a unique int element, measured over N insert operations.
container.unordered_set.int_insert.description_zh: std::unordered_set<int>::insert 插入唯一 int 元素的平均单次开销，基于 N 次插入操作测量。

container.unordered_set.int_find_hit.description_en: Average cost of one successful std::unordered_set<int>::find on a container of size N, measured over N lookups.
container.unordered_set.int_find_hit.description_zh: 大小为 N 的 std::unordered_set<int> 上单次成功 find 查询的平均开销，基于 N 次查找测量。

container.unordered_set.int_iteration.description_en: Per-element iteration cost for std::unordered_set<int>, measured by traversing all N elements.
container.unordered_set.int_iteration.description_zh: std::unordered_set<int> 的单元素遍历开销，通过遍历全部 N 个元素测量。
